Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

Decant (development version)

  • ambient_de() gains robust = TRUE (default): outlier samples are down-weighted per gene by Huber weights, the dispersion is re-estimated under them, and the residual degrees of freedom are reduced to match. Without it, cohorts of 50 or more samples per group with a few extreme counts gave 16 to 41% false positives on null genes (the failure Li et al. 2022 report for NB tests). DecantDE() inherits the default.
  • ambient_de() estimates the ambient term more accurately:
    • joint_rho = TRUE: each sample’s ambient fraction is refined on genes that look absent across all samples pooled, which removes an upward bias of about one point; its sampling variance now enters the model.
    • soup_design = TRUE, and soup_eb(design = ): soups are shrunk toward the design-fitted soup, not a condition-blind mean.
  • ambient_de(max_ambient_frac = 0.75): genes whose counts are mostly soup are not tested and are listed in attribute "ambient_dominated". Previously most such genes were dropped only as a side effect of the over-estimated ambient fraction.
  • ambient_de(lfc = ): test against a minimum fold change (as limma’s TREAT), for cohorts large enough that sub-1% biases become significant.
  • New simulate_ambient_cohort() and gate_ambient_de_cohort(): large cohorts with outlier samples, heavy-tailed noise, or a confounding batch.
  • run_all_gates.R exits non-zero when a required gate fails; CI runs each gate once.
  • experiments/large_cohort_calibration/: sweep over 6 to 200 samples per group, with its limits.
  • New validation/de_comparators.R: contamination-aware DE against correct-then-test with the official SoupX, DecontX, FastCAR and CellBender (each run only if installed). Wrappers live in validation/comparators.R.
  • README: the claim that correcting counts first does not stop DE leakage is narrowed. It holds for Decant’s default subtract rule; official SoupX followed by edgeR removes almost all leakage on the simulator.
  • New vignette, “Contamination-aware differential expression”.
  • pkgdown site configuration and deployment workflow.
  • DESCRIPTION: URL, BugReports, biocViews, VignetteBuilder.
